## Opportunities {.section-title}
<hr class="section-rule">

We welcome applications from motivated students and researchers who share our interest in the 
evolution of humans and primates. The lab is based at the 
[School of Anthropology and Museum Ethnography](https://www.anthro.ox.ac.uk/), 
University of Oxford.

Please read the descriptions below and [get in touch](mailto:thomas.puschel@anthro.ox.ac.uk) 
with a CV and a brief description of your research interests before making a formal application.

---

```{=html}
<div class="opportunity-box">
  <span class="badge-type">DPhil (PhD)</span>
  <h4>DPhil Students</h4>
  <p>
    We supervise DPhil students through the 
    <a href="https://www.ox.ac.uk/admissions/graduate/courses/dphil-anthropology" target="_blank">
    DPhil in Anthropology</a> at the University of Oxford. Strong candidates will have a 
    background in biological anthropology, evolutionary biology, zoology, or a related field, 
    and ideally some experience with quantitative or computational methods (morphometrics, 
    phylogenetics, biomechanics, or statistics).
  </p>
  <p>
    Funding is available through Oxford's graduate scholarship schemes and external fellowships 
    (e.g. Clarendon, NERC DTP). We encourage prospective students to contact Thomas 
    <strong>well in advance</strong> of application deadlines to discuss project ideas.
  </p>
</div>

<div class="opportunity-box">
  <span class="badge-type">Postdoctoral</span>
  <h4>Postdoctoral Researchers</h4>
  <p>
    We are interested in hosting postdoctoral researchers through fellowship schemes such as:
  </p>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="https://www.leverhulme.ac.uk/early-career-fellowships" target="_blank">Leverhulme Early Career Fellowship</a></li>
    <li><a href="https://royalsociety.org/grants/newton-international/" target="_blank">Newton International Fellowship (Royal Society)</a></li>
    <li><a href="https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/" target="_blank">Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions</a></li>
    <li><a href="https://wellcome.org/grant-funding/schemes/early-career-awards" target="_blank">Wellcome Early Career Award</a></li>
    <li><a href="https://www.hfsp.org/funding/hfsp-funding/postdoctoral-fellowships" target="_blank">HFSP Postdoctoral Fellowship</a></li>
  </ul>
  <p>If you are interested in applying for any of these with Thomas as a sponsor, please get in touch.</p>
</div>

<div class="opportunity-box">
  <span class="badge-type">Visiting</span>
  <h4>Visiting Researchers & Students</h4>
  <p>
    We welcome visiting researchers and graduate students for short- or medium-term stays. 
    Oxford offers several mechanisms for formal visiting student status. Please contact 
    Thomas to discuss possibilities.
  </p>
</div>
```
